boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Muhlenberg College
boards.description: Ten currently documented food destinations in Allentown with service extending to at least 11 p.m.; check the linked venue page before leaving, since hours can change.

cards.title: El Tablazo
cards.subtitle: 147 N 7th St, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s order link or call ahead for a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday late meal; its posted schedule lists service until 2 a.m. on those days.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Dominican restaurant with documented 2 a.m. weekend and Sunday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: El Tablazo lists 147 N 7th St in Allentown and business hours until 2:00 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: until 2:00 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday; Monday–Thursday close earlier. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: 849 Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 343 Hamilton St, Allentown
cards.notes: Plan this downtown stop for Thursday through Sunday evenings, then verify the day’s schedule on the restaurant site before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Hamilton Street restaurant whose posted schedule reaches 1 a.m. on four nights.
cards.evidence_claim: 849 Restaurant lists its Allentown address as 343 Hamilton St and posts 1:00 a.m. closing on Thursday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted late hours: 1:00 a.m. Thursday–Sunday; Monday–Wednesday close at 10:00 p.m. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Denny's on Catasauqua Road
cards.subtitle: 1871 Catasauqua Rd, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check the current day’s hours before a late food run; the page posts service through 11:58 p.m. on several days.
cards.short_summary: A Denny’s location with official late-evening hours listed by day.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its 1871 Catasauqua Rd Allentown location with hours through 11:58 p.m. Thursday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists service through 11:58 p.m. Thursday–Sunday; Monday–Wednesday schedules differ. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Anthony's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 502 W Gordon St, Allentown
cards.notes: Choose this Gordon Street pizzeria when a late takeout or delivery option fits the plan; its site posts 1 a.m. weeknight and 2 a.m. weekend closing.
cards.short_summary: A locally listed pizza destination with official 1–2 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Anthony's Pizza lists 502 W Gordon St in Allentown and hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on South Fourth Street
cards.subtitle: 1761 S 4th St, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to select carryout or delivery and confirm the operating mode; it posts late hours for all three options.
cards.short_summary: A South Fourth Street Pizza Hut with posted service extending past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists 1761 S 4th St in Allentown and posts restaurant hours until 2:00 a.m. daily, with dine-in until 1:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page posts delivery and carryout until 2:00 a.m. daily and dine-in until 1:30 a.m.; confirm mode before travel.

cards.title: Domino's on East Susquehanna Street
cards.subtitle: 2 East Susquehanna St, Allentown
cards.notes: Check the location page, then place a pickup or delivery order for this South Allentown store; the official listing currently shows a 1 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Domino’s Allentown location with an official 1 a.m. closing listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's lists its store at 2 East Susquehanna Street in Allentown as open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 2 East Susquehanna Street
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently states “Open Today Until 1:00 AM.” Check the live page for the applicable day.

cards.title: Wendy's on Broadway Street
cards.subtitle: 4688 Broadway St, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-thru when the posted midnight closing works for your timing, and check the official page again before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway Street Wendy’s with midnight restaurant and drive-thru hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its 4688 Broadway Street Allentown location as open until 12:00 a.m. daily for both restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.access_notes: Official page posts restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. daily. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Wendy's on Cedar Crest Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 450 S Cedar Crest Blvd, Allentown
cards.notes: For a later drive-thru or restaurant pickup, consult the location page before departure; it currently lists the same 1 a.m. close every day.
cards.short_summary: A Cedar Crest Boulevard Wendy’s with official daily 1 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its 450 S Cedar Crest Blvd Allentown location as open until 1:00 a.m. daily for restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.access_notes: Official page posts restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. daily. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Cooper Street
cards.subtitle: 301 Cooper St, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru late and distinguish it from dine-in service: the official page posts later drive-thru hours, particularly on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Cooper Street Taco Bell with drive-thru service through 2 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists 301 Cooper St in Allentown with drive-thru hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is posted until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: The Dime Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Renaissance Allentown Hotel, 12 N 7th St
cards.notes: For a seated downtown meal, use the restaurant’s late-night menu window and verify availability before going; it lists food service from 9 to 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A hotel restaurant with a distinct nightly late-food service window.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dime Restaurant at the Renaissance Allentown Hotel lists late-night food service from 9:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Late Night from 9:00 p.m.–11:00 p.m. Check reservations and current service before travel.
